records.observation: Global HashMap initially null; init loads classloader system resource by supplied name, missing resource logs/exits1. Replaces map with capacity800; default-charset InputStreamReader and BufferedReader20480, each line tokenized as three decimal RGB integers then one-or-more name tokens joined with separator. No blank/comment handling; insufficient tokens/invalid numbers or ColorAlpha argument faults escape (only IOException caught, logged/exit1). Duplicate names overwritten, map potentially partially populated on parse failure; readers not closed. Lookup null name fails indexOf before fallback, uninitialized map also fails. Strips first colon and all suffix, does not lowercase/trim lookup; exact HashMap key returned as shared ColorAlpha. Unknown non-null key logs and calls ColorAlpha.getNextDefaultColor, not inserted into map, so fallback behavior depends on separately unread ColorAlpha state. Colon suffix not used as pattern/alpha here. getString iterates HashMap entries with counter, no sorted order. Demo initializes jumpshot.colors and prints navy blue and green:dimple3 lookups, not executed. Resource contents and ColorAlpha implementation remain separate evidence/dependencies.
